definitions.short: Merajoth , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H4812. Merayoth מְרָיוֺה proper name, masculine (on form compare Lag BN 51 ); — 1 descendant of Aaron: a. grandfather of Ahitub and great-grandfather of Zadok 1 Chronicles 5:32; 1 Chronicles 5:33; 1Chr 6:37 ; Ezra 7:3 ; ᵐ5 Μαρειηλ , Μαρερωθ , Μαραιωθ , etc. b. as son of Ahitub and father of Zadok 1Chr 9:11 ; Neh 11:11 ; ᵐ5 Μαρμωθ Μαρ ( α ) ιωθ . 2 name of a priestly house Neh 12:15 (probably error for מְרֵמוֺת , q. v., 12:3 ), ᵐ5 L Μαριμωθ .
